name: Margaret Paul
reason: Health rule / therapy: her own site (innerbonding.com, which redirects to innerbondinghub.com; home page read 6 Nov 2026) sells Inner Bonding, created by two psychologists, as emotional healing of 'anxiety, depression, addiction' and similar conditions, set against 'most therapeutic processes'; the work is mainly psychotherapeutic and condition-led, so almost nothing would pass the strict health-claim rule.
